resources.string: Attempts to stop about %1$d min after the app is in the background and tasks have finished.
No timed idle shutdown. Safe shutdown after Android reclaims the app still applies.
Default: 2 minutes. Choose 1–30 minutes. Returning to the app cancels the timer; completing background tasks restarts it.

Timing is approximate. TensorIMS does not keep itself alive for this timer, and Android scheduling may affect it. With longer delays, Android may reclaim the app before the timer ends. The embedded service will also exit once tasks and permission cleanup are confirmed complete, without waiting for the full delay. This safety mechanism remains active when this switch is off.
Applied settings, original-value backups, and pairing data are retained. Next time, start the service manually; wireless debugging may require additional steps.
